messages:
maria: noticing repeated short spikes in queue_depth on eu-west-1 this morning, correlated with GPU saturations. dashboards show very noisy panels, hard to tell real vs transient. :thinking_face: link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcdef/queue-overview

kai: saw that too, thanks for flagging. looks like our debounce on the queue_depth alert is 30s — too low for the bursty traffic pattern from scheduled batch jobs. propose we bump to 90s and add a short moving_avg on the panel.

ben: do we have a probe metric we can emit to separate real saturation from transient backpressure? otherwise rerouting to spare capacity could mask the underlying KV cache issue. cc @oncall

maria: good call. we don't currently emit a probe. thinking of adding a cheap synthetic probe that pages the queue with a single small request and measures enqueue_latency. if enqueue_latency stays high for >90s we treat as sustained.

kai: draft PromQL for an alert debounce idea:```
avg_over_time(queue_depth_total{region="eu-west-1"}[2m]) > 120
&&
avg_over_time(enqueue_latency_ms{region="eu-west-1"}[2m]) > 50
```
This avoids firing on 10-20s blips.

maria: sounds good. also want panel-level smoothing so SRE oncall can visually separate noise. suggest moving to a 1m rolling mean on the grafana panels for queue depth and batch_size.

ben: pragmatic rollout: 1) add probe metric + short exporter change (low risk) 2) update dashboard smoothing and add annotation when probe fails 3) update alert rule debounce to 90s 4) backfill for last 72h to validate no missed incidents.

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Alert queued: `queue_saturation_high` (eu-west-1) triggered at 1717001204 — firing on 3 hosts.

maria: opening a small PR for the probe & exporter change now, will include the Prometheus job config snippet and Grafana panel JSON. if folks agree I'll follow with the alert rule patch and rollout notes in ops/runbooks.

kai: please include a note to avoid changing autoscaler target while we're triaging — that could hide the root cause. also add a short test to the CI that simulates 30s bursts so we don't regress.

ben: ack. if you want I can pre-provision a tiny eu-west spare pool to redirect traffic while we validate. low-cost, low-risk.

maria: appreciate it. tagging this for postmortem if rollout changes correlate with cost spikes: @finance FYI. will update thread with PR links and timeline when done. :white_check_mark:
